**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

The governing law and venue provisions sit in General Provisions (a) (p0145–p0146):

- **Governing law:** internal laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles — our preferred jurisdiction.
- **Forum:** suits must be instituted in the City of New York, with irrevocable submission to the **exclusive** jurisdiction of the S.D.N.Y. or any New York State court, plus waivers of venue objections and forum non conveniens.
- **No arbitration clause anywhere** in the document, and no competing forum (the only other court reference is the standard severability "court of competent jurisdiction" in p0151, and p0147 merely addresses out-of-state service of process, which reinforces rather than displaces New York jurisdiction).

Immaterial notes (rationale only, not deviations): venue is drafted as the "City of New York" rather than "New York County," and there is no express temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out — the latter makes exclusivity stronger for us. No change requested.
